name: Kite ne! Mahou Senshi no Gakuensai ~Fandisc no Otome-tachi~
original_name: 来てね！魔法戦士の学園祭～FANDISCの乙女たち～
source:
The protagonist is a regular person invited by the Kamishima sisters to visit the Hakuyou Festival. This festival aims to showcase the achievements of students from the prestigious Hakuyou Magic Academy and educate people on how magic influences economics, industry, and politics.

Accompanied by the sisters, the protagonist first watches their starring film, "Magical Warriors Serena & Sincere" — a bold, documentary-style dramatization by director Kagashima Itsuki, blending campus life with the enigmatic exploits of the rumored magical warriors. Though meant to depict their heroic deeds, unrelated footage suddenly cuts into the narrative:

"This is the truth."

The inserted scenes show the magical warriors engaged in lewd acts...
Behind it all, the shadowy agenda of a certain individual comes into view...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=620105]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角是受神岛姐妹邀请来参加白阳祭的常客。这个节日旨在展示著名的白阳魔法学院学生的成就，并教育人们了解魔法如何影响经济、工业和政治。

在姐妹俩的陪伴下，主角首先观看了她们主演的电影《魔法战士赛琳娜与辛瑟尔》，这是一部大胆的纪录片风格的戏剧，由导演鹿岛树执导，将校园生活与传闻中的魔法战士的神秘事迹融为一体。尽管本是为了描绘他们的英雄事迹，但不相关的镜头突然切入了叙事：

“这是事实。”

插入的场景显示了魔法战士们从事猥亵行为……
在这一切的背后，某个人的阴暗议程映入眼帘……

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=620105]Getchu[/url]]
